# Risk tiers of pull requests, read from the target branch by the CI job `risk` and applied by
# scripts/risk-tier.ts. One pattern per line, relative to the repository root:
# `**` matches any number of directories and `*` matches within one directory level.
# Any changed file matching a high pattern makes the pull request high risk; when every changed
# file matches a low pattern it is low risk; otherwise it is medium risk. High wins over low, and
# a pull request from a release/* branch is always high risk.

[high]
# Repository automation, agent instructions and the task runner.
.github/**
lefthook.yml
.claude/**
AGENTS.md
CLAUDE.md
REVIEW.md
Taskfile.yml
# Configuration of the check tools.
eslint.config.mjs
.prettierrc.json
.prettierignore
.dependency-cruiser.cjs
.jscpd.json
commitlint.config.mjs
.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc
.gitleaks.toml
tsconfig.json
vitest.config.ts
playwright.config.ts
# Screenshot baselines.
**/*-snapshots/**
# Sign-in, database schema and migrations, environment files and hosting configuration.
**/auth/**
drizzle/**
**/*.sql
**/.env*
vercel.json

[low]
.docs/**
**/*.md
**/*.txt
LICENSE
